Control family: SR 1.1 Human user identification and authentication
Design treatment: Operator and administrator actions require explicit authenticated identity and role context.
Review evidence: User-role mapping and audit records for privileged actions.

Control family: SR 1.2 Software process and device identification
Design treatment: Collectors, relays, and services use scoped machine identity instead of shared trust.
Review evidence: Service identity configuration and certificate assignment.

Design treatment: Approved sources, actions, and targets are policy-bound and revocable.
Review evidence: Connection allowlists, policy records, and blocked-action logging.
